Thousands of people have profited from this currency and it has appreciated more than 75 times last year. Bitcoin was one of the most successful financial investments of 2013. Clearly, a new era is born in digital currencies. And today, you have the unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called OneCoin. One Coin will be introduced through our education program, where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with your cryptocurrency. With our education packages, you will receive free trading tokens, so-called oneTokens. These tokens will give you the possibility of trading in our exchange with thousands of other members, practise your skills and let you profit from what you have learned through our One Academy program. The One tokens can be exchanged once you feel proficient enough to start trading with cryptocurrency. As a member you will get your own back office where you will learn about the One coin concept, get access to your education packages, and follow the progress of this business. Stay updated on the latest news. Follow your tokens portfolio via the backoffice and see it grow through our split program. The split program can double your token portfolio. Each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times This means if you are active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks. textual.context: Presented as a promotional description of the OneCoin/One Network program; the stated outcome is conditional on being active.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed portfolio-value increase is expressly linked to active participation and a stated short timeframe.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish how a person becomes active, whether assets can be withdrawn or exchanged, the value of tokens, or whether the described increase occurs.

textual.observation: The speaker says people can qualify for bonuses by becoming an active marketing partner, popularizing OneCoin, and building a sales team.
